snippet.title: Manala: Equinox War Trailer
snippet.description:
Manala: Equinox War is a deckbuilding mini-MMO with full-loot PvP. The free demo is out now on Steam.

The gear you wear decides which cards you can play. Pick up a two-hander and the same Attack card hits harder. Buy a shield and cards you could not play before become playable. There are no levels and no stat boosts, so your build changes at the merchant instead of at a level-up.

Fight other players in card combat, alone or with up to four friends.

When you die you lose everything you were carrying. It stays on your body for anyone to pick up, and it works the same the other way around: kill a player and you take their gear.

Five classes, two sides, one map. Take regions off the enemy and you decide who controls the battlefield.

▶ Free demo on Steam:
https://store.steampowered.com/app/4898080/?utm_source=youtube&utm_medium=description&utm_campaign=demo_launch

Full game launches November 5, 2026.

The demo is single-player and ships two of the five classes, mage and smith. PvP, area conquest and the other three classes are in the full game.

Made by one person, in build since January 2026.

Music: "Volatile Reaction" by Kevin MacLeod (incompetech.com), licensed under Creative Commons: By Attribution 4.0
https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/4.0/
